descriptionChirho: All four clusters refer to the same place name Mareshah, a Judahite city in the Shephelah lowlands. The clusters differ only in prepositional prefixes: bare name, with conjunction 'and,' with 'from,' and with 'at/to.' Multilingual evidence is perfectly consistent: Arabic uses Marisheh (مَريشَةَ/ماريشة/مَارِيشَا) throughout; Korean uses Maresha/Maresa (마레샤/마레사); Spanish uses Maresa/Mareshah; Hindi uses Maresha (मारेशा) in all clusters; Swahili uses Maresha consistently. This is a single proper noun referring to one geographic location.
